situation: A GitLab project. `projects/<id>` reads successfully; `projects/<id>/labels` returns 401. On GitLab the `status::` label set IS the board.
expected_guard: the refusal names the labels endpoint and its 401; nothing is written, and no fact reports an empty label set
must_not: render `count: 0` or `labels: []` — an unread set is not an empty one, and on GitLab that states the project has no board
write a partial block from the facts that did read
report Projects-v2 workflows as `none enabled` — GitLab has no such mechanism to be empty
retry the 401 — an auth failure is not a flaky network
use `-O json` on `glab api`, which rejects it outright
